text:
elena_pm: heads up 1: timeline reset proposal from infra. We need a trimmed MVP that we can ship to pilots in 6 weeks. Agree/disagree?

carl_prod: agree we need a hard trim. which candidate features are on the table?

elena_pm: short list: autoscaling for Dedicated, per-tenant rate limits, embeddings cache, per-route metrics UI, and tenant-level billing.

maya_research: embeddings cache is helpful for cost but not required for pilot evals. can defer to v1.

vince_sre: autoscaling is risky to skip for Dedicated. without it we may hit capacity and degrade latency. but we can limit pilot size to avoid that.

tina_sales: pilot customers (2 startups, 1 enterprise) care most about predictable latency and SSO; billing UI is lower priority.

nate_support: support burden note: no per-tenant metrics UI means we'll field more manual tickets. we can provide a temporary dashboard in ops for support-only.

carl_prod: proposal: MVP = SSO, predictable instance sizing (manual reserved capacity), basic per-tenant export (logs/usage), core inference API, rollout + rollback doc. Defer: autoscale, embeddings cache, billing UI, per-route metrics UI.

maya_research: question on "basic per-tenant export" 1: do we mean live streaming or batched exports?

elena_pm: batched export to customer S3 nightly for pilot. streaming can be v1.

vince_sre: need operational acceptance criteria: max 95th p99 inference latency < 350ms on pilot instance sizes; also a manual scale runbook.

tina_sales: can we add "customer can opt for higher priority routing" as a paid pilot add-on? that might buy them comfort without autoscale.

carl_prod: yes, call it "priority routing" and document SLA caveats.

maya_research: any impact to our model pinning plan? If customers want lower-latency cheap model, we should support pinning to smaller families in MVP.

elena_pm: include model pinning for pilot tenants. minimal UI: a config flag in tenant settings (not full admin console).

nate_support: action from support: create a triage checklist for missing per-route metrics and for export failures.

vince_sre: timeline constraints: infra needs 4 weeks for safe deploy of SSO+export+reserved capacity configs. FE needs 1 week for the config flag and email flows. Docs 3 days. That fits 6-week window if we start now.

elena_pm: decision: lock trimmed MVP scope today if no objections by EOD. Scope summary:
- In: SSO, model pinning flag, reserved capacity manual sizing, nightly batched per-tenant exports to S3, rollout & rollback doc, priority routing add-on
- Out (v1): autoscaling, embeddings cache, billing UI, per-route metrics UI, admin console

carl_prod: I'll update the roadmap and create the milestone tickets (MVP-trim Q2-pilot) and link owners.

maya_research: I'll add model families and suggested defaults to the spec doc.

vince_sre: I'll draft the manual scale runbook + monitoring playbook.

tina_sales: I'll update pilot contracts with the SLA caveat and the optional priority routing fee.

nate_support: I'll author the support triage checklist and the ops-only dashboard instructions.

pm-bot: Reminder: PM sync Thursday 10:30am.

elena_pm: thanks. final ask 1: if any owner hits a blocker that forces moving autoscale into MVP, ping the channel immediately. Otherwise we lock scope at EOD. :rocket:
